SELECT m.id, i.category, i.sub_category AS subCategory, i.indicator_code AS indicatorCode, i.title, COALESCE(f.facility_name, '전체') AS facility, m.reporting_year AS year, CONCAT(m.reporting_year, '-', LPAD(CAST(m.period_value AS TEXT), 2, '0')) AS period, m.numerical_value AS value, i.unit, m.data_source_type AS source, 'API/MANUAL' AS method, -- 스키마에 따라 고정 또는 로직 처리 m.status, m.evidence_file_url AS evidence, CASE WHEN m.status = 'REJECTED' THEN '위험' ELSE '정상' END AS risk, m.reject_reason AS aiFinding, u.name AS assignee FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON m.indicator_id = i.id LEFT JOIN company_facilities f ON m.facility_id = f.id LEFT JOIN users u ON m.input_user_id = u.id
AND i.category = #{category}::esg_category_enum
AND m.reporting_year = #{year}
AND m.status = #{status}::data_status_enum
ORDER BY m.reporting_year DESC, m.period_value DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE esg_metric_data SET numerical_value = #{numericalValue}, evidence_file_url = #{evidenceFileUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE esg_metric_data SET status = #{status}::data_status_enum, approver_user_id = #{approverId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
